 The Dell NativeEdge platform will automate the delivery of NVIDIA AI Enterprise software, helping developers and IT operators easily deploy AI applications and solutions at the edge. Advancements also include the ability to simplify AI application development for faster time to value with the integration of NVIDIA NIM inference microservices, deployment automation and more.

## About Michael Dell

---

M ichael Dell is an American technology entrepreneur who founded Dell Technologies, one of the world's largest PC and IT infrastructure companies. His journey began in 1984 from his dorm room at the University of Texas, where he started a business called PCs Limited, building and selling custom-upgraded personal computers directly to customers. This direct-to-consumer model was revolutionary, cutting out the retail middleman and allowing for lower prices and greater customization. He dropped out of college to focus on the business, which was renamed Dell Computer Corporation.

Dell's direct model fueled decades of explosive growth, making it the world's largest PC maker for a time. In 2013, in one of the largest leveraged buyouts in history, he and the private equity firm Silver Lake took Dell private to restructure the company away from the declining PC market and towards more profitable enterprise solutions. This led to the massive $67 billion acquisition of the data storage giant EMC in 2016, which transformed Dell into a powerhouse in cloud computing, servers, and storage. Dell later took the company public again. In addition to his role at Dell, he manages his family's considerable fortune through his private investment firm, MSD Capital.
